confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from inspected listings or live prices. Restaurant meal anchors are moderately reliable; the beer, cocktail and wine anchors are weakest because alcohol availability and pricing vary in Rajasthan and are often lower-confidence. Hotel tiers are estimated for July, a low season in Jaisalmer, and actual rates may vary with fairs, festivals and demand. FX: the 2026-10-15 figure (0.6955) is attributed in search results to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page, but I did not open the page to verify it. A 2026-10-16 figure of 0.6947 appeared only on a secondary site and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Rajasthan tourist towns such as Jodhpur and Udaipur, adjusted to Jaisalmer's smaller, budget-oriented guesthouse and hostel market. Drink prices are set relative to local beer prices, with a premium for cocktails and wine in tourist-facing restaurants.
